title: GROWTH: two counted witnesses, both drifting 11 and 13 ULP
upstream_status_verbatim: Exponential-regression drift around `11`-`13` ULP on the bounded witnesses.
status_plain: GROWTH has exactly two counted rows against a live oracle and both of them miss: the catalogue witness drifts 11 ULP and the geometric witness 13 ULP. Both sit in the version-controlled 2026-07-10 reconnaissance corpus, whose reference environment is Excel 16.0 build 20131 on an x86-64 host with Compatibility Version 2, stated once for the pass and not restated on the G3-04 row. No GROWTH pass figure exists, and the lane survey states that no GROWTH live witness corpus exists at all on either exact-geometric or noisy data. A conditional decomposition result does exist alongside TREND's - given the coefficients, GROWTH(x*) = b*m^x* reproduces Excel at 0 ULP - but that is a statement about the prediction step, not about GROWTH.
open_question: No GROWTH witness corpus exists on exact-geometric or noisy data.
reader_warning: Two rows, both misses. Do not read the catalogue's conditional "the PREDICTION path is bit-exact" as a statement that GROWTH matches Excel; it is conditional on being handed the coefficients.
